description: The server answers one of the client's own pings twice. OVERVIEW.md section 2.7 ping/pong field table: 'a duplicate pong -> ignore + count'. welcome uses the wire floor keepalive values (ping_interval 30000ms, ping_timeout 90000ms per section 2.9). wait_ms (35000) is plain protocol time: comfortably past the up-to-ping_interval first-ping jitter (OVERVIEW.md section 2.9: 'First ping jittered by random(0, ping_interval)'), so the client's first autonomous ping has definitely been sent by then. The scripted `send:ping` step below is observe-only (its `ts` is whatever the client's real clock produced, never asserted -- same convention as pong_for_unsent_id.json/ping_pong_then_dead_peer_timeout.json's server-role pong fixtures); the two `recv:pong` steps that follow reuse its literal `id`/`ts` only to read as the compliant echo section 2.7 requires ('A pong MUST carry the same id and ts'), not because either value is checked against the real ping.
